'''Razke''' was a [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] serving in the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. Razke was assigned to [[Team Razor]], and was part of the team that established [[Outpost Cinder]]. The commanding [[Major/Legends|Major]] ordered Razke to set up the outpost's command center.<ref name="HS" />
